default.text: Flour's sold by the sack, weighed on my scale, and paid for before it leaves the hill. If you've come to look at the sails, looking is free.

mill.text: My grandfather's stones. Every loaf Elda bakes was mine first. This village eats because that turns; some on the council forget it.

wedding.text: My Anwen, to Rook's brother Dunn. The twenty-fourth. The whole village is asked and I'm paying, so mind how much you eat.

options.text: You must be proud of her.
A wedding costs. Can the mill carry it?
A lot of coin to feed people who forget you.

wedding_kind.text: Prouder than I let on. Her mother would have... well. The twenty-fourth. Come, if you're still about.

wedding_plain.text: It can. I've counted. I count everything; that's why there's a mill to count.

wedding_hard.text: Hm. You've a sour tongue. Not a wrong one.
